entities.summary: Alexandrovsk is a town in Perm Krai, Russia, located on the Lytva River, 185 kilometers (115 mi) northeast of Perm, the administrative center of the krai. Population: 14,495 (2010 census); 16,231 (2002 census); 20,073 (1989 Soviet census).
